content.title: Implement URL-driven dashboard filtering
content.description:
Implement the URL-parameter-driven filtering for the issues dashboard per the plan.

Scope:
- Status selector defaults to 'Open' (meta-status mapping to todo + in-progress + done).
- 'Idea' and 'Closed' statuses only appear when explicitly selected.
- Status, search, and assignee filters all read from AND write to URL search params (react-router useSearchParams). URL is the single source of truth — remove the local useState filter state in IssuesPage.
- Changing any control updates the URL; navigating to a bookmarked URL applies the saved filters.
- Clear-filters resets the URL params (back to the default 'Open' state).

Must pass typecheck + lint + existing tests before marking done.

content.content:
Done. Implemented URL-driven dashboard filtering per the plan.

## What was delivered
- Filter state (status, search, assignee) now lives entirely in the URL via React Router's `useSearchParams` — the local `useState` in IssuesPage is gone. Filters are bookmarkable/shareable, and back/forward navigation works for free.
- The dashboard **defaults to the "Open" view** on first load (status absent = Open). Open maps to todo + in-progress + done; "idea" and "closed" only appear when explicitly selected. "All statuses" is a distinct explicit choice.
- Search input is debounced (~250ms) so typing doesn't churn the URL/history per keystroke; status and assignee update immediately.
- Clear-filters resets the URL to the clean root (default Open). Unknown/garbage status values fall back to Open without error.
- The URL is kept clean: the root path is never rewritten to `?status=open`.

## New/changed code
- NEW `use-issue-filters.ts` hook (single source of truth over URL params), plus a `DashboardStatus` type.
- `IssuesPage`, `IssueFilters`, `IssueList` (empty-state predicate fixed for the new Open default), and `issuesApi.list` (excludes `idea` client-side only when status is Open, so backend semantics are untouched).

## One scope note for your awareness
The Create Issue dialog previously defaulted new issues to "idea" status. With the new Open-default dashboard, that meant every newly-created issue vanished from the dashboard. I changed the dialog's default to "todo" so new issues are visible immediately — a necessary coherence fix for this feature. Flagging in case you want to treat that as a separate product decision.

## Test updates (existing tests, not new coverage)
Several existing e2e tests created issues with the default "idea" status and expected them visible in the dashboard — which conflicts with the new Open-default behavior by design. I updated their seed data to use a visible status (todo) so they keep testing what they intend (root-only listing, navigation, dialog create). No test assertions/logic were weakened.

## Verification
- Typecheck (`tsc -b`): passes.
- No lint is configured for the webapp.
- Full Playwright e2e suite: 158 passed, 4 failed — the 4 failures are the pre-existing, intentional Phase 4 "BUG-2" sync tests (documented known gaps, unrelated to this task). No regressions.

## Note for the validator (mqguhe7eyw)
All deep-linking scenarios from the plan work (status=closed/idea/all, assignee, debounced search, clear, back/forward, garbage-status fallback). One edge case to be aware of: immediately switching the status filter right after creating an issue showed a transient render flicker in one isolated run (the data is correct in the network layer); a direct deep-link to any status view is unaffected.
